transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling kind of foggy. At work I’m making little mistakes in my client notes, forgetting what I was about to do. That’s not really like me.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… I guess I have. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I can still get through work and talk to people, but inside I just feel kind of sad and… flat.
Are you still able to enjoy activities that you normally like to do?
I’m not really sure. I still do some things, but I don’t know if I’d say I’m enjoying them much.
How long have you been feeling this sad and flat?
About a month, I think. It’s just kind of been hanging over me… the low, guilty, foggy feeling.
Have you been having any thoughts of death or suicide?
Um… not like I’m planning to do anything to myself. But… there have been a few mornings where I’ve thought maybe it wouldn’t be so bad if I just didn’t wake up. That kind of scares me.
Have you been able to perform daily tasks and maintain your personal care without much difficulty?

Mostly, I guess. I’m getting by. But at work I’ve had to ask coworkers to double-check my client notes, and at home my wife’s been handling some of the bills and scheduling… I’m just not great with details right now.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt okay, or were you feeling down or sad every single day?
I mean… I’ve had moments where I can get through my shift and talk to people okay. But pretty much every day I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like inside I’m just… sad and flat.
Have you had any significant loss of interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?
I’m not sure. I still do some things, but… they don’t really feel the same, I guess. I haven’t thought about it much.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty most of the time?
Yeah… I guess guilt more than worthless. I keep going over what I should’ve done before my tío died—calling more, visiting sooner. It feels like I failed him, like I didn’t do right by family.
Have you been experiencing significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?
Sleep, yeah… it’s been kind of all over. I’ll lie there thinking about family stuff, or I wake up before my alarm and can’t really get back to sleep. Appetite… I haven’t noticed as much.
Have you had any periods in the past month where you felt so bad that you couldn't get out of bed or take care of yourself?

Not like… stuck in bed all day, no. But I haven’t been on top of things. At work I’ve had coworkers double-check my client notes, and at home my wife’s been handling some bills and scheduling because I’m missing details.
Have you had any days in the past week where you felt no sadness at all?
Not really. I mean, I can get through my shift and talk to people, but most mornings I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling… like I’m just sad and flat inside.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt nearly back to your normal self?
Not really. Maybe little moments, but… that low, guilty, foggy feeling’s been hanging around for about a month now.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt so bad that you couldn't do even the smallest tasks without help?

Not that bad, no. I can still do basic things. It’s more… I’m not as reliable with details. At work I’ve had coworkers double-check my client notes, and at home my wife’s been taking over some bills and scheduling.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt completely unable to work or take care of yourself?

No… not completely unable. I’ve still been going to work and taking care of myself. I’ve just had to ask coworkers to double-check my notes, and my wife’s been handling some bills and scheduling because I’m not really on top of details right now.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt like you were barely able to function at all?

Barely functioning? No, I wouldn’t say that. I’m still getting through things. I just… I’ve needed coworkers to double-check my client paperwork, and my wife’s been handling some bills and scheduling because I’m not really reliable with details right now.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt like you couldn't take care of yourself at all?

No, not like I couldn’t take care of myself at all. I’m managing. It’s more the details… at work I’ve had people double-check my client documentation, and at home my wife’s been handling some bills and scheduling.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt like you were unable to work at all?

No… I haven’t been unable to work at all. I’ve still gone in. I just need coworkers to double-check my client documentation right now, because I’m not as solid with the details. And at home my wife’s been taking over some bills and scheduling.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt completely back to your normal self?
Not really. It’s been… about a month where I’ve had this low, guilty, foggy feeling hanging over me. I don’t think I’ve felt completely normal in that time.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt so low that you thought you might be better off dead?
Yeah… a few mornings, I guess. I’m not planning to hurt myself or anything, but I’ve had that thought that… maybe it wouldn’t be the worst thing if I just didn’t wake up. And that scares me.
